author: SunMaple
quote: There is no doubt that it is an excellent game, worthy of 9.5 points. However, the European and American media have overly praised it in order to gain a say in the game industry. It has almost no guiding significance for the development of the game industry. It only has graphics and details, and cannot play a landmark role of epoch-making. Moreover, there are issues such as poor plot rhythm and the suspicion of forcing players to please the female protagonist. Neither emotionally nor rationally should one be able to stand in this position. Therefore, I choose to give this score to express my dissatisfaction with the media ratings.
